* '''Playtest''' ([[Force Projection (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-forceprojection-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/forceprojection.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “USED: If [Episode VII] Luke at a site, target another site. Your characters there are defense value = 5 this turn. LOST: Once per game, if opponent just drew battle destiny (and Luke is out of play), draw destiny and subtract that amount from opponent's total battle destiny.”
* '''Original''' ([[Force Projection]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-forceprojection-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/forceprojection.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: “USED: If [Episode VII] Luke at a site, target all your characters at one other site. They are defense value = 5 this turn. LOST: Once per game, if opponent just drew battle destiny and Luke is out of play, draw destiny and subtract that amount from opponent's total battle destiny.” '''What changed:''' before release: “target another site. Your characters there are defense value = 5 this turn” became “target all your characters at one other site. They are defense value = 5 this turn”; “(and Luke is out of play)” became “and Luke is out of play” (parentheses dropped); the art credit “Image courtesy of Mark Tuttle” and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” were added; re-rendered with sharper graphics.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-forceprojection.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/forceprojection.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: “USED: If [Episode VII] Luke at a site, target all your characters at one other site. They are defense value = 5 this turn. LOST: Once per game, if opponent just drew battle destiny and Luke is out of play, draw destiny and subtract that amount from opponent's total battle destiny.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution.
*: [[File:V11-L-forceprojection-20230329-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
